cfMeDIP-seq Protocol — Stage Tables

Shen et al. 2019 · Burgener et al. 2021 · Wilson et al. 2022

STAGE 1 — Library Preparation  ·  Day 1  ·  Steps 1–3
Steps
#NameProcessing (Time)
1End-Repair & A-Tailing Repair ends to blunt; add 3′ A-overhang; input 1–10 ng cfDNA (2–3 h)
2Adapter Ligation Ligate methylated adapters carrying unique molecular barcodes (2–3 h)
3SPRI Purification SPRI bead cleanup; remove excess adapters and enzymes (1 h)
Variability
SourceLevel
DNA input quantity & integrity MOD
Ligation efficiency; dimer formation MOD
SPRI ratio; ethanol wash LOW
Metrics
MetricMethodInterpretation & Limit
cfDNA input Qubit, pre-Step 1 <1 ng → stochastic library · ≥1 ng
Post-ligation yield Qubit, post-Step 3 Low → insufficient library · ≥80% of input
Adapter dimer % Bioanalyzer, post-Step 3 High → wasted reads · <20%; no peak
STAGE 2 — Methylated DNA Immunoprecipitation  ·  Day 2  ·  Steps 4–10  ·  ⚠ Core; highest variability
Steps
#NameProcessing (Time)
4Filler + Spike-Ins Bring total DNA to ~1 µg; add meth + unmeth spike-in controls (30 min)
5Denaturation 95°C, 10 min → ssDNA; chill on ice (15 min)
6Anti-5mC IP 5 µg anti-5mC antibody; 16–18 h, 4°C with rotation (16–18 h)
7Bead Capture Protein A/G magnetic beads capture antibody–DNA complexes (2 h)
8Washing 3–5× IP buffer washes; remove non-specific DNA (30 min)
9Elution Proteinase K at 50°C releases IP DNA from beads (2–3 h)
10IP Purification SPRI cleanup of eluate; primary measurement checkpoint (1 h)
Variability
SourceLevel
Filler DNA type (meth vs unmeth) HIGH
Antibody lot-to-lot efficiency HIGH
Wash stringency (# and vigor) MOD
Antibody conc.; incubation temp. MOD
Bead binding; ProtK activity LOW
Metrics  (all measured at Step 10)
MetricMethodInterpretation & Limit
IP recovery yield Qubit, post-Step 10 Very low → IP failure · 0.1–5 ng
Methylation specificity GATE qPCR, spike-in primers <95% → poor enrichment; do not proceed · >95%
Fold-enrichment GATE qPCR, HIST1H2BA/GAPDH <25 → IP or antibody failure · >25-fold
Spike-in balance qPCR, spike-in primers Imbalanced → batch effect · >19:1
STAGE 3 — Library Amplification  ·  Day 3  ·  Steps 11–14
Steps
#NameProcessing (Time)
11qPCR QC qPCR on IP aliquot: HIST1H2BA (pos.) vs GAPDH (neg.); Go/No-Go gate (2 h)
12PCR Amplification 12–15 cycles; indexed primers; high-fidelity polymerase (2 h)
13Size Selection SPRI bead cleanup; select 200–600 bp; remove adapter dimers (1 h)
14Library QC Qubit/qPCR for concentration; Bioanalyzer/TapeStation for size; Go/No-Go gate (1 h)
Variability
SourceLevel
PCR cycle number → dup. rate MOD
GC amplification bias MOD
qPCR primer efficiency LOW
SPRI size-selection ratio LOW
Metrics
MetricMethodInterpretation & Limit
Ct value qPCR, Step 11 aliquot Ct >30 → low IP recovery · <30
Fold-enrichment GATE qPCR, Step 11 <25 → repeat IP · >25-fold
Specificity GATE qPCR, Step 11 <95% → repeat IP · >95%
PCR cycles used Operator record >15 → elevated duplication & bias · 12–15
Fragment size peak Bioanalyzer, Step 14 Off-target → size-selection issue · 250–400 bp
Adapter dimer peak Bioanalyzer, Step 14 Present → repeat SPRI · absent
Library concentration GATE Qubit/qPCR, Step 14 <2 nM → re-amplify · ≥2 nM
STAGE 4 — High-Throughput Sequencing  ·  Day 4+  ·  Step 15
Steps
#NameProcessing (Time)
15Paired-End Sequencing Pool equimolar libraries; Illumina PE 2×75 or 2×150 bp; target 5–20 M read pairs per sample (Day 4+)
Variability
SourceLevel
Sequencing depth; sensitivity HIGH
Base-call quality; cluster density MOD
GC/CpG density capture bias MOD
Library pooling imbalance LOW
Metrics
MetricMethodInterpretation & Limit
Raw read count Sequencer output Low → insufficient sensitivity · 5–20 M pairs
Q30 % FASTQC Low → base-call errors, false calls · >85%
Adapter content FASTQC High → trim failure; alignment bias · <5%
Mapping rate GATE BWA / SAMtools flagstat <90% → contamination or library failure · >90%
Duplication rate GATE Picard MarkDuplicates >30% → over-amplification; data compromised · <30%
Properly paired rate SAMtools flagstat Low → library structure issue · >85%
Insert size peak Picard InsertSizeMetrics Off-nucleosomal → size-selection failure · ~166 bp
CpG enrichment GATE MEDIPS CpG.enrichment <1.5 → IP failure; exclude sample · >1.5
Saturation MEDIPS saturation Not saturated → under-sequenced · plateau
Spike-in read counts BWA to spike-in genome Inconsistent → Stage 2 batch effect · stable across batch
Spike-in meth/unmeth ratio Custom demultiplexing <19:1 → poor IP specificity · >19:1

GATE = formal Go/No-Go decision point  ·  Limits in green = hard thresholds  ·  Limits in amber = advisory
